items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: I played with all of them... What did Martin play? Drums.

ctx.x: So you played with Lee Collins too, Goodwilded. Lee Collins, yeah. Yeah. That's the band that you made a record with? Huh? That's the band you made a record with? Yeah, I made the camera record with them. Who was in that band when you made a record?
Morgan, Albert Morton. Morgan, Albert Morton. What did Martin play?
What? What did Martin play? Drums. Oh, you ever said drums?
